user.title: Add CYD gateway
user.description: Enter the gateway ID, controller ID, and binding token provisioned in the CYD firmware. The gateway must use the same MQTT broker.

error.mqtt_unavailable: Configure and enable the MQTT integration first.
error.cannot_connect: The gateway handshake failed. Check the gateway ID, token, broker ACL, and gateway availability.
error.invalid_gateway_id: The gateway ID must be cyd_ followed by 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_controller_id: The controller ID length is invalid.
error.invalid_binding_token: The binding token must be 32 to 128 bytes.
error.invalid_area: The selected room area does not exist.
error.room_too_long: The room area name exceeds the firmware limit of 32 UTF-8 bytes.
